WITH ZZ AS ( SELECT #{writeType} AS WRITE_TYPE , TO_DATE(#{startDate} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS START_DATE , TO_DATE(#{endDate} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1 AS END_DATE FROM DUAL ) SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.TimeStatsMapper : 시간대별통계 LIST */ DD.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD , MAX(DD.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM) AS GUBUN , MAX(DD.SRTNG_SQNCE) AS SRTNG_SQNCE , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '00', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T0 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '01', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T1 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '02', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T2 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '03', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T3 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '04', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T4 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '05', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T5 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '06', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T6 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '07', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T7 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '08', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T8 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '09', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T9 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '10', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T10 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '11', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T11 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '12', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T12 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '13', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T13 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '14', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T14 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '15', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T15 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '16', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T16 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '17', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T17 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '18', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T18 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '19', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T19 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '20', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T20 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '21', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T21 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '22', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T22 , SUM(DECODE(DD.TIME, '23', EE.CCNT,0) ) AS T23 , SUM(NVL(EE.CCNT,0)) AS SUM FROM ( SELECT BB.CMMNS_CD_VALUE , CC.TIME , BB.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM , BB.SRTNG_SQNCE FROM ( SELECT AA.* FROM SAC100 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'MM_DSCSN_STATS_TYPE_SE_CD' /* 월상담통계유형구분코드 */ ) BB , ( SELECT TO_CHAR(LEVEL-1, 'FM00') AS TIME FROM DUAL CONNECT BY
LEVEL <= 24
) CC WHERE 1=1 ) DD , ( SELECT AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'HH24') AS TIME , COUNT(*) AS CCNT FROM
AYE100 AA /* 사이버상담게시글 */
AYE120 AA /* 사이버상담답글 */
, ZZ WHERE 1=1 AND '1' = ZZ.WRITE_TYPE
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= ZZ.START_DATE AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < ZZ.END_DATE
GROUP BY AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'HH24') ) EE WHERE 1=1 AND EE.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD(+) = DD.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AND EE.TIME(+) = DD.TIME GROUP BY DD.CMMNS_CD_VALUE ORDER BY 3
